normalization: Part 2 starter: training-only channel statistics, epsilon=1e-6 V
reproducibility: Strict deterministic kernels by default; same stack/device required for bitwise repeats.

eegnet_part1_config.architecture:
EEGNet(
  (block1): Sequential(
    (0): Conv2d(1, 8, kernel_size=(1, 80), stride=(1, 1), padding=(0, 40), bias=False)
    (1): BatchNorm2d(8, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
  )
  (block2): Sequential(
    (0): Conv2d(8, 16, kernel_size=(64, 1), stride=(1, 1), groups=8, bias=False)
    (1): BatchNorm2d(16, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
    (2): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (3): AvgPool2d(kernel_size=(1, 4), stride=(1, 4), padding=0)
    (4): Dropout(p=0.5, inplace=False)
  )
  (block3): Sequential(
    (0): Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=(1, 16), stride=(1, 1), padding=(0, 8), groups=16, bias=False)
    (1): Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=(1, 1), stride=(1, 1), bias=False)
    (2): BatchNorm2d(16, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)
    (3): ELU(alpha=1.0)
    (4): AvgPool2d(kernel_size=(1, 8), stride=(1, 8), padding=0)
    (5): Dropout(p=0.5, inplace=False)
  )
  (head): Linear(in_features=240, out_features=2, bias=True)
)

vanilla_transformer.architecture:
VanillaEEGTransformer(
  (proj): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=64, bias=True)
  (encoder): TransformerEncoder(
    (layers): ModuleList(
      (0-2): 3 x TransformerEncoderLayer(
        (self_attn): MultiheadAttention(
          (out_proj): NonDynamicallyQuantizableLinear(in_features=64, out_features=64, bias=True)
        )
        (linear1): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=128, bias=True)
        (dropout): Dropout(p=0.3, inplace=False)
        (linear2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
        (norm1): LayerNorm((64,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (norm2): LayerNorm((64,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
        (dropout1): Dropout(p=0.3, inplace=False)
        (dropout2): Dropout(p=0.3, inplace=False)
      )
    )
  )
  (norm): LayerNorm((64,), eps=1e-05, elementwise_affine=True)
  (head): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=2, bias=True)
)
